## Built

- ArtScript (creator): a full-stack web language that compiles to small, dependency-free JavaScript plus a Node server, designed for AI agents. https://artscript.dev · https://github.com/leb90/ArtScript
- Reactpify (author): the easiest way to add React components to any Shopify theme, with Liquid sections generated from component props; Vite, Tailwind, Redux and metaobjects. https://github.com/leb90/reactpify
- Ático de Hisui: Shopify storefront for a trading-card and collectibles shop, with a custom theme. https://aticodehisui.com
- World of Argentum: a classic 2D fantasy MMORPG in the browser, rendered on canvas. https://worldofargentum.io
- This site: rain physics on canvas (collisions against a raster of the letters, splashes with restitution, an umbrella you can hold), written entirely in ArtScript. https://github.com/leb90/portfolio
